notes:
**You can export a backtest now.** The full spreadsheet - every trade, the running equity, monthly buckets, what the run actually covered - was six hundred lines of finished, tested code that nothing in the app could reach. Its own comment said the screen would hand the report over. No screen did. There is a share button on the report now.

The exported file says what the run ACTUALLY covered, not what was asked for: a year is requested and a contract that has lived a month returns a month. A trade with no timestamps is left out rather than given a made-up date. And it refuses to export a run whose option could not be priced - those numbers are hidden on the screen for a reason, and putting them in somebody's inbox would undo that.

**Two more sentences that were written and never shown.** An index reports no volume, so a rule about VWAP was measured against something that is not VWAP - the report never said so. And a rule whose greeks the chain would not serve took no trades and reported "this rule never entered a trade", which reads as a verdict on your rule when it is a verdict on the data.
